readme:
# Bazel for Java (community fork, Bazel 9)

Adds Bazel support to Language Support for Java by Red Hat (`redhat.java`, installed automatically as a dependency): the Eclipse JDT language server imports your Bazel workspace, computes the classpath from `BUILD` files and gives you diagnostics, completion and navigation across targets. The fork bundles a language-server build patched for Bazel 9 / bzlmod and current `redhat.java` releases.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

## What works in Diode

Workspace import and synchronization (Java: Synchronize Projects with Bazel, Refresh Bazel Projects, Update Classpath), the `.bazelproject` project view, the Bazel Build Status terminal with the synchronization log, BUILD / Starlark highlighting and buildifier formatting.

## What does not

The Bazel Targets tree view is not rendered (Diode has no extension tree views yet), and run targets imported from IntelliJ run configurations cannot be executed (there is no task runner). You need `bazel` or `bazelisk` on PATH; the language server identifies a workspace by a `WORKSPACE` or `WORKSPACE.bazel` file, so keep an (empty) one even under bzlmod.
